        visited[start_r][start_c] = True
        while queue:
            r, c = queue.popleft()
            component.append((r, c))
            for dr, dc in [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]:

                if 0 <= nr < rows and 0 <= nc < cols and not visited[nr][nc] and grid[nr][nc] != 3:
